threshold_selection_rationale: Threshold 0.50 selected after exhaustive PR-curve sweep across all candidate thresholds. XGBoost scale_pos_weight=3.0 already biases the probability distribution recall-first, making 0.50 the empirically optimal point for FN minimization (FN=19 on 4127-sample test set). Raising the threshold to 0.583 (best F2) increases accuracy to 94.8% and reduces FP by 51, but increases FN from 19 to 31 -- unacceptable for a safety-critical early warning system.
high_sensitivity_rationale: Use threshold=0.3546 for maximum-sensitivity operation (Recall=99.53%, FN=10). Produces more false positives (FP=~370) but misses fewest events. Intended for monsoon peak season or high-alert operational modes only.
domain_rationale: For a landslide early warning system, False Negatives (missed landslide events) are safety-critical failures. False Positives cause alert fatigue but are operationally recoverable. This informed the use of scale_pos_weight=3.0 during training and the selection of threshold=0.50 as the default operating point.
